concerns.text: T014 (Environment Logging) and T017a (Validation) depend on trace data existence, but T015b (Real Data Ingestion) and T015 (Synthetic Generation) are listed AFTER T014/T017 in the Phase 2 block. T014 explicitly requires 'data/processed/environment_logs.json' which implies data processing, yet the data generation tasks (T015b/T015) are not marked as prerequisites. The 'Note on Data Streams' clarifies this, but the task list order violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule.

T029 (Solvent Model Partitioning) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but the description explicitly states: 'This task is sequential: fetch -> partition -> write. It MUST NOT be marked as parallel [P].' The [P] tag is incorrect and creates a false parallel execution assumption.

T030b (Statistical Reporting) depends on T030a (Bayesian Correlation), but both are listed under the same 'Implementation for User Story 3' block without explicit sequential ordering in the task list structure. While dependencies are noted in text, the task list should reflect the strict 'Producer (T030a) before Consumer (T030b)' flow to prevent parallel execution attempts.

T045 (Detection Limit Verification) depends on T051 (Calibration Protocol), but T051 is listed AFTER T045 in the Phase 6 block. T045 requires calibration data to calculate detection limits, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' ordering.

T039 (Full Pipeline Integration Test) is listed in Phase 8 but depends on T026 (Phase 4) and T034 (Phase 5). While the dependency is noted, T039 should be positioned immediately after the completion of Phase 5 in the execution flow, or Phase 8 should be explicitly defined as 'Post-Phase 5 Integration' to avoid confusion about when this critical gate occurs relative to Phase 6/7 enhancements.
